subject: Environmental Studies
stem: An EVS teacher has students keep a small kitchen garden at school, observing and recording how plants grow over weeks, connecting classroom learning to a real, ongoing activity. This teaching approach chiefly develops:

options.option_text: Observation skills and a sense of responsibility through sustained, hands-on engagement
Only rote memorisation of plant names

explanation: Sustained, hands-on activities like a school garden build observation skills, patience, and a sense of responsibility — core EVS pedagogical goals beyond simple factual recall.
